name: Classic Woodworks
old_description: Classic Woodworks of MI is a family owned custom woodturning, woodworking and cabinet shop. We specialize in wood turning and one of our favorites is large diameter turned pedestal table bases. We can also duplicate your vintage turnings such as spindles, newel posts, porch posts, etc.  We look forward to hearing from you as to how we can assist you with your home decor or historical restoration project.
about:
Classic Woodworks of Michigan, Inc. operates from Capac, a small community in St. Clair County, Michigan. The company is family-owned and led by president Doug Clayton, with his son Luke Clayton serving as shop foreman and lathe operator, and Laura Clayton as office manager. The business began as a custom woodturning, woodworking, and cabinet shop, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in wood turning, with a particular focus on large-diameter turned pedestal table bases and island bases. Its capabilities extend to planing, jointing, sanding, and sizing of sheet goods, supporting the design, manufacture, and installation of custom cabinetry and architectural millwork. The facility produces a wide range of turned components—including table legs, newel posts, balusters, columns, porch posts, finials, and corbels—and can duplicate vintage turnings for historical restoration. The team also builds staircases, church furniture, store fixtures, and commercial millwork.

Classic Woodworks serves residential, commercial, and institutional clients. Homeowners and designers engage the shop for home libraries, dens, offices, media centers, fireplace surrounds, mantels, bookcases, custom built-ins, wine cellars, wainscoting, and coffered ceilings. Commercial projects include store fixtures and general commercial millwork, while institutional work encompasses church furniture and staircases. The company also supports historical restoration projects requiring replication of original spindles, newel posts, and porch posts.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure and hands-on expertise in wood turning as key differentiators. It positions itself as a single-source provider for custom wood components, from design through installation, with the ability to match historic profiles for restoration work.
